newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil buoyed by cargo deal.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil buoyed by cargo deal.

text.p: NWE straight-run fuel oil prices were supported on Thursday by a cargo deal struck at above numbers seen earlier this week, traders said.
Daewoo sold low sulphur straight-run to the French Mediterranean coast at $93.75 fob, some $4 above Tuesday's deal for a very prompt Irish cargo.
There was heard to be market interest for a 20,000 tonne top-up cargo to go transatlantic.

Russian cargoes were actively offered with two E-4 cargoes from Klaipeda, plus another unspecified cargo, all believed picked up by the British major who has dominated the market for Russian material recently.
Black Sea straight-run cargoes were less actively talked, with the St. Nicholas 2, with high sulphur M100 aboard, still on offer.
